x: Welcome also to Graham Adams and Simon Maynard, too late to effectively strengthen the squad, but a glance at the December 8th Surrey League result showed what is possible.
Richard, Simon, Matt and Garry could have got a medal most years previously. Adam and John finished well but probably found the course rather tough.
Other wins came from Marcus(200),Simon ( B S/C), Femi ( a magnificent 16.38 TJ), and Andy Hutchinson (HJ). The high jump proved to be our top points event with Ossie and Andy for a 2nd and 1st.

Thomas is son of Simon, grandson of Brian and great-grandson of the late Thomas Pritchard who joined 10th June 1924. And talking of new arrivals - congratulations to Jane and Charles Herrington on the safe arrival of baby daughter Hannah May, born on Thursday 12th October and weighing in at 6lbs 10ozs.
